# rauthy_role (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Rauthy role by name, for referring to roles this configuration does not manage.

Requires the `Roles:read` API key right.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Refer to a role that was created outside this configuration.
data "rauthy_role" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rauthy-assigned identifier of the role.
